title: Delegated Decision Protocol for Top-Account Priority Reservations
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a lightweight, operational protocol that allows Customer Success and Sales to reserve roadmap surface area for top accounts via delegated decisions. The protocol should define reservation tiers, decision delegation boundaries, time-boxed commitments, fallbacks, and telemetry hooks so engineering and PMs can honor commitments with predictable capacity impact.
background: We receive high-touch requests from strategic customers that frequently require faster prioritization than the normal intake queue. Current ad-hoc escalations create inconsistent promises to customers and frequent churn for Eng/Platform. PMs need a repeatable mechanism that balances commercial commitments with roadmap integrity and engineering capacity.
proposal: Introduce a two-tier reservation system: Temporary Reservation (T-Reserve) for 6–12 week time-boxed experiments and Strategic Reservation (S-Reserve) for multi-cycle partnerships with formal SLAs. Define delegated decision agents (CS Director + Sales AE for T-Reserve; CRO + Head of Product for S-Reserve) with a short digital form to request reservation. Implement a reservation ledger in Notion/Confluence and automatic signals to the roadmap planner and the Console backlog via the intake webhook.
acceptance_criteria: Reservation types and decision authorities documented and approved by GTM/Prod/Engineering
Intake form implemented and accessible (Confluence + intake webhook) with required fields: customer, impact, required deliverable, window, fallback
Telemetry: reservation created/approved/released events are emitted to tracking pipeline (Datadog event + roadmap dashboard card)
Engineering has clear cost estimate template attached to every reservation and a prescriptive fallback policy
Pilot run with 3 top accounts completed and retrospective documented
tasks: Draft formal decision matrix and thresholds (Aisha)
Coordinate legal/commercial guardrails for S-Reserve commitments (Marcus)
Implement intake form + webhook (PM -> ENG: intake ticket ENG-38104)
Add reservation ledger page in Confluence and link to roadmap planner
Instrument telemetry events (Datadog) and add dashboard card (Eng Observability)
Run 3-account pilot and collect outcomes and customer feedback
risks: Over-committing engineering capacity if decision thresholds are too lax
Sales/CS may game T-Reserve if SLAs not enforced; requires audit trail
Operational overhead for tracking small reservations could erode productivity
Legal/commercial commitments in S-Reserve might create long-term obligations
outcomes: Clear, time-boxed pathway for fast-tracking top-account asks without derailing roadmap
Measured telemetry to prove reservation impact on delivery and unit economics
Reduced escalation noise to PM and Eng by delegating low-risk approvals
Stronger alignment between GTM and Product on customer success SLAs
